gold_sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-90.90066 42.771108, -90.939037 42.771256, -90.941338 42.843364, -90.941816 42.858317, -90.902064 42.858184, -90.783699 42.857787, -90.780969 42.770701, -90.90066 42.771108))', 4326) AS g
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g)
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast))).max AS elevation
FROM clipped;
